explanation: Generated 3×3 kinematic grid for η-meson electroproduction (ep→e'pη) on protons using EtaMAID-2023 hadronic model. Grid spans W = 1.55–1.75 GeV (3 points) and Q² = 0.5–1.5 GeV² (3 points) at fixed center-of-mass scattering angle cos θ* = 0 and azimuthal angle φ* = 90° (9 total kinematic points). Configuration uses CLAS12 beam energy (bmom = 6.53 GeV), inelasticity cut vcut = 0.166 GeV² (per CLAS12 η analysis), and full O(α) radiative corrections (rc_mode = 0). All parameters are within valid physical ranges for EtaMAID-2023 tables (W ∈ [1.4856, 6] GeV, Q² ∈ [0, 5] GeV²).
